definitions.explanation: The practice sword used in kendo, made from four strips of split bamboo bound together. It stands in for a real sword in training and matches.

examples.japanese: {竹刀|しない}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧。
examples.english: to take a stance with the bamboo sword

examples.japanese: ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{竹刀|しない}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧。
examples.english: I swing a shinai during kendo practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{竹刀|しない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{割|わ}れ→割る：02334_waru⟧やひび⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
The bamboo practice sword used in ⟦{剣道|けんどう}→剣道：04452_kendou⟧ (kendo), made of four bamboo staves bound with leather fittings so practitioners can strike safely. The reading ⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ is irregular and does not follow the on'yomi of the kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {竹刀|しない}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧: to take a stance with the shinai
- {竹刀|しない}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to swing the shinai
- {竹刀|しない}{稽古|げいこ}: practice with the bamboo sword
